entries.subject: LAM/SPHERE MPCD: selected reconstruction
entries.finding: The current LAM 3Dshape directory lists 87_Sylvia_mpcd.obj, matching the actual preparation input. The retained measurements describe 2898 vertices and 5792 facets in km; the recipe preserves that source scale. This review checked the release listing and local source/recipe binding, not a fresh mesh reconstruction or new source-fit test.

entries.subject: Elevation
entries.finding: Radius minus 137 km, false color over −50 to +70 km; broad shape, not gravitational height.

entries.subject: Position
entries.finding: Retained Sylvia vector at 3 September 2026 TT, shared with Romulus.

entries.subject: Released ADAM companion model
entries.finding: The live directory also lists 87_Sylvia_adam.obj. The body’s retained model comparison already distinguishes this ADAM reconstruction from the selected MPCD mesh. It is not adopted as a duplicate view of the same measured shape; the original comparison remains linked.
entries.revisitWhen: An observation or scientific comparison specifically requires this alternative mesh and its matching source frame.
